risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI Agent Self-Modification Controls, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Accountability / Attribution (R-AC-1), Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Unauthorized / Harmful Autonomous Action (R-AI-3), Unintended or Unsafe Technology Behavior (R-AI-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Technologies (AAT) System Failure or Unintended Behavior (MT-13), Adversarial Artificial Intelligence (AI) Attack (MT-29).

compensating_control_1.name: Access Enforcement
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege."
compensating_control_1.justification: Access Enforcement (IAC-25) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Self-Modification Controls (AAT-39.15) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Self-Modification Controls (AAT-39.15) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
